content.short: walt.id provides open source decentralized ID and ID wallet infrastructure for developers and organizations.
content.description: walt.id delivers open-source, decentralized identity (DID) and ID wallet infrastructure that enables developers to design, deploy, and scale end-to-end use cases and applications quickly and with confidence. The Community Stack provides a comprehensive open-source suite for managing ID wallets as well as issuing and verifying digital identity credentials, supporting rapid iteration and collaboration. The Enterprise Stack offers a powerful framework for large organizations or SaaS platforms to build reliable, scalable identity systems.
